basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 35.' and it opens 'Vers. 35. Ac ille non sensit, nec quando illa accubuit, | nec quando surrexit. Hoc Judaei'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 35. Ac ille non sensit, nec quando illa accubuit, | nec quando surrexit. Hoc Judaei in tantum non recipiunt, ut quoties hunc locum legunt compungantur. Dicunt enim non posse fieri ut homo non sentiens concumbat.
